Fixture: 51_vardct_mixed_gray_128x128_nofilters_d4.jxl
128x128 greyscale, VarDCT lossy, gaborish and EPF disabled, d=4.0

Purpose
-------
Same source and filter setting as 50, at a coarser target distance (d=4.0
vs. d=1.0), to give the "no filters" class a second, lossier operating
point. See 50's sidecar for the source recipe (smooth ramp / 1px checkerboard
split) and the general rationale (varblock zoo, black-box oracle use,
grading-against-reference-decode-not-source).

--gaborish=0 --epf=0 disables both restoration filters, so per 18181-3
Annex A Table A.1 this is again the tighter class:

    Part 3 error class:  peak <= 0.004,  RMSE <= 1e-5   (no filters)

  cjxl flags:   -d 4.0 --gaborish=0 --epf=0 -e 7

    Shape (1, 128, 128, 1) little-endian f32, per 18181-3 4.1.2. Readable
    with jpxl_conformance::FloatImage::from_npy.
    Regenerable at any time from the fixture with the pinned djxl build
    (decode is deterministic per libjxl revision, see PINNED_REVISIONS.txt).

cjxl/djxl are used strictly as BLACK BOXES: they emit/consume conformant
streams for JPXL to parse. libjxl's source is never read. If a rebuild at a
different libjxl revision changes these digests, that is the point of
recording them -- do not silently update them; note the revision change.
